caseName: Briggs v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: BRIGGS, doing business as WALT'S AUTO PARKS & GARAGES v. CITY OF LOS ANGELES
attorneys: Morris Lavine for appellant., Roger Arnebergh and Philip E. Grey for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Frankfurter took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
